items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: so Eddie Heywood said, "Turn her loose! Man, man, man, turn her loose so she can take her encore!"

ctx.x: I have some notes here about the days of Cafe Society. You mentioned Canada Lee; and were there some fights?

Oh, the fights. That was the most exciting thing. It was during the war. We had quite a few biased people to come up like from the South. They didn't understand a lot of things, like mixing and all that. Sundays you couldn't get in the club. They were outside standing and waiting to come in and like every other night there was a big fight. At this particular time I done a request of 'Roll 'Em' and it went over big. Some bright guy in the audience said, "Play it again!" He ran up and grabbed me and was holding me…
Josh White was there too, wasn't he?
